== Branches.simpleIf (line 2)
| simpleIf(a)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      instruction
        | a := 1
    -
  jump
    | gib a

== Branches.ifElse (line 9)
| ifElse(a)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      instruction
        | a := 1
    -
      instruction
        | a := -1
  jump
    | gib a

== Branches.elseIfChain (line 18)
| elseIfChain(a)
  alternative
    | a < 0?
    -
      jump
        | gib "negative"
    -
      alternative
        | a == 0?
        -
          jump
            | gib "zero"
        -
          alternative
            | a < 10?
            -
              jump
                | gib "small"
            -
              jump
                | gib "large"

== Branches.nested (line 30)
| nested(a, b)
  alternative
    | a > 0?
    -
      alternative
        | b > 0?
        -
          jump
            | gib 1
        -
      jump
        | gib 2
    -
  jump
    | gib 3

== Branches.logic (line 40)
| logic(a, b)
  alternative
    | a > 0 && b > 0 || a < -10?
    -
      jump
        | gib true
    -
  jump
    | gib false

== Branches.ternary (line 47)
| ternary(a)
  instruction
    | b := a > 0 ? a : -a
  jump
    | gib b
